level_description: Deep Dependency Chains, Zero Bypass (Every field in this set is genuinely LLM-sampled -- there are no deterministic assignments anywhere, no field the LLM doesn't have to actually choose. What makes these hard is that later fields' valid ranges are computed from several earlier fields at once, across nested spec instances, forming a long chain of context-sensitive validation. This isolates the core claim -- constrained decoding beyond what a context-free grammar can express -- from any contribution by the deterministic solver.)

DEP_project_task_schedule.name: Sequential Project Task Schedule
DEP_project_task_schedule.description: Models the standard project-scheduling rule used by every real Gantt-chart tool (MS Project, Jira, Asana): a task cannot start before its predecessor finishes. Each of 5 tasks' start day is bounded below by the previous task's own (independently LLM-sampled) start day plus duration -- a relation a context-free grammar cannot express, since it constrains one free choice against the combination of two other free choices made earlier in the same document.

prompts.system: You are a project management tool generating a validated sequential task schedule. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate a 5-task project schedule where each task starts only after its predecessor finishes, all within the project deadline.

DEP_flight_multi_leg_itinerary.name: Multi-Leg Flight Connection Itinerary
DEP_flight_multi_leg_itinerary.description: Models the real airline scheduling rule that a connecting flight cannot depart before the previous leg lands plus a minimum connection time. Three legs, each independently LLM-sampled, chained by validation constraints only -- no field's value is ever computed for the LLM, only bounded by the combination of several already-generated ones.

prompts.system: You are an airline scheduling system generating a validated 3-leg connecting itinerary. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate a 3-leg flight itinerary where each connection respects the minimum layover time.

leg2.description: departure_offset_hours must be >= leg1.departure_offset_hours + leg1.flight_duration_hours + min_layover_hours

leg3.description: departure_offset_hours must be >= leg2.departure_offset_hours + leg2.flight_duration_hours + min_layover_hours
